description: This file defines the AesGcmEncryptingStream class, implementing AES-GCM encryption stream functionality for the AWS SDK, including methods for encryption, retrieving encryption parameters, and interfacing with stream objects.

classes.name: AesGcmEncryptingStream
classes.description: Implements a data stream that encrypts data using AES-GCM encryption, providing methods for stream creation, encryption parameters retrieval, and metadata.

methods.name: getStaticAesName
methods.description: Returns the static name of the AES encryption mode (AES/GCM/NoPadding).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the AesGcmEncryptingStream with specified parameters such as plaintext stream, key, IV, AAD, tag length, and key size.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher method name based on the key size.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES name, currently via static method for backwards compatibility.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Retrieves the current initialization vector used for encryption.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a stream with encrypted data, using different methods depending on PHP version.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication tag generated during encryption.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not writable.
